title: Understanding Codons
text: Remember that a codon is a sequence of $$3$$ DNA letters. Since each letter can be one of T, G, C, or A, how many different combinations can you form with $$3$$ letters?

title: Calculating Codon Combinations
text: To find the number of possible codons, consider that each position in the codon can be filled by one of $$4$$ letters. How would you calculate the total number of combinations for $$3$$ positions?

title: One-Hot Encoding Codons
text: If you one-hot encode each codon, how many dimensions will you have for each codon?

title: Total Dimensions for DNA String
text: Once you know the number of dimensions for one codon, think about how many codons are in a DNA string of $$3000$$ letters. How would you calculate the total number of dimensions for the entire string?

title: Calculating Total Dimensions
text: If each codon has $$64$$ dimensions and there are $$1000$$ codons in a DNA string, what is the total number of dimensions for the string?
